text:
Maya (AE): We just received an RFP from Meridian Health. They want: capability matrix, completed security questionnaire, and a short POC pricing appendix. Deadline in 72 hours. I uploaded initial sheet: https://redwood.app/files/meridian_matrix_draft.xlsx

Leo - Solutions: Quick scan 
- Target: ~4.5k embeddings qps peak.
- They want BYOK + HSM options and the POC must allow model pinning.

Priya (Infra): 4.5k qps is doable on dedicated with proper batching. Suggest 6 x A100-80GB, dynamic batching up to 512, KV cache enabled. If they select Private deployment, HSM verification adds ~2 business days.

Omar (Security): I'll start filling the questionnaire. Key issues: HSM attestation, key custody, logging retention. We can provide SOC2 and encryption whitepaper. Flagging the incident notification SLA to Legal.

Leo - Solutions: I'll fill the capability matrix with measured qps for fp16 and 8-bit quantized models, and add a POC ops checklist + bench command: `ri bench --model redwood-embed-v2 --concurrency 110 --batch-max 512 --duration 600`. Will include reserved vs hosted examples for pricing.

build-bot: POC sandbox job queued: job/meridian-poc-sbox (eta 1777779400).

Maya (AE): Action items: Leo - matrix + pricing appendix (due tomorrow EOD). Priya - infra checklist + peering steps (due tomorrow EOD). Omar - questionnaire + attachments (due in 2 business days). I'll compile and send.

Priya (Infra): Adding note: if they want audit logs pushed to their SIEM, we can stream to their S3 or syslog; include as optional line item.

Omar (Security): Uploaded SOC2 and KMS guide links in the draft folder.

Maya (AE): Thanks all, please drop drafts here and I'll assemble.
